APIs.APIs_DESC: This section lists all the APIs of the Ocu driver.

API.API_SYNTAX: void Ocu_Init ( const Ocu_ConfigType * const ConfigPtr )
API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info
API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to initialize all relevant registers configured hardware (AssignedHWUnit) with the values of structure referenced by the parameter ConfigPtr. The API will also disable all notifications and the OCU channel status will be set to OCU_STOPPED.
For multicore, the function will initialize those channels allocated to the core in which this function is invoked. Additionally for master core, the function will initialize the resources which are shared among cores.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info
API.API_DESC:
The purpose of this API is to de-initialize the OCU driver. The used peripherals/registers will be set to power-on reset state. The API will disable all used interrupts and notifications.
For multicore, the function will de-initialize those channels allocated to the core in which the function is invoked.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the OCU channel

API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to enable notifications from an OCU channel.
For multicore, the OCU channel shall be allocated to the core in which the function is invoked.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the OCU channel

API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to disable notifications from an OCU channel.
For multicore, the OCU channel should be allocated to the core in which the function is invoked.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the OCU channel

API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to read the current value of the counter.
For multicore, the OCU channel shall be allocated to the core in which the function is invoked.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_RETURN.API_PARAMDESC: To indicate whether, writing the threshold value to the compare register was within or outside the reference Interval.

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the OCU channel
Value given by the upper layer and used as a base to determine whether, writing the threshold value to the compare register was within or outside the reference Interval.
Value to compare with the content of the counter. This value is in ticks.

API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to set the value of the channel threshold using an absolute input data.
For multicore, the OCU channel should be allocated to the core in which the function is invoked.
Decision: Ocu_SetAbsoluteThreshold API will return OCU_CM_OUT_REF_INTERVAL if a DET/Safety Error is reported. Rationale : As the enumeration value of OCU_CM_OUT_REF_INTERVAL is numerically minimum (ZERO), it is chosen as a default return value if an error is identified.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info
API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to indicate to the driver the action to be taken by the hardware upon compare match. The action will be disable, high, low or toggle.
For multicore, the OCU channel should be allocated to the core in which the function is invoked.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: State of the pin to set. OCU_HIGH or OCU_LOW

API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to set the level of the pin associated to an OCU channel to high or low.
For multicore, the OCU channel should be allocated to the core in which the function is invoked.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_RETURN.API_PARAMDESC: To indicate whether, writing the threshold value to the compare register was within or outside the reference Interval.

API_IN.API_PARAMDESC: Numeric identifier of the OCU channel
Value to use for computing the new threshold.

API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to set the value of the channel threshold to the relative current value of the counter.
For multicore, the OCU channel should be allocated to the core in which the function is invoked.
Decision: Ocu_SetRelativeThreshold API will return OCU_CM_OUT_REF_INTERVAL if a DET/Safety Error is reported. Rationale : As the enumeration value of OCU_CM_OUT_REF_INTERVAL is numerically minimum (ZERO), it is chosen as a default return value if an error is identified.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info
API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to start the OCU channel.
For multicore, the OCU channel should be allocated to the core in which the function is invoked.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info
API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to stop the OCU channel.
For multicore, the OCU channel should be allocated to the core in which the function is invoked.

API.API_SYNTAX: Std_ReturnType Ocu_InitCheck ( const Ocu_ConfigType * const ConfigPtr )
API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_RETURN.API_PARAMDESC: E_OK: if initialization comparison is success. E_NOT_OK: In case of - Input configuration pointer is NULL. - ConfigPtr received in InitCheck is not same as used in Init. - Driver is not initialized. - If any of the GTM TOM and ATOM channel is not initialized - SFRs not having expected value.

API.API_DESC:
The purpose of the API is to check the values set during the OCU driver initialization are as per the config structure. The API does not modify any SFR/variable and only a read operation is performed.
The API is called after Ocu_Init() is done to check for the correctness of initialization. In case any failure is observed in comparison, the API returns E_NOT_OK.

API.API_SAFETY_LEVEL: Refer to the release notes for the safety related info

API_OUT.API_PARAMDESC: Pointer to store the version information of the module

API.API_DESC: The purpose of the API is to return the version information of the OCU driver. The version information includes: Module ID, Vendor ID., vendor specific version numbers. This function is available only if the OCU_VERSION_INFO_API is ON.
API.USER_HINTS: The API can be called before OCU initialization.

CONTAINER.CONTAINER_DESC: Configuration of Ocu (Output Compare Unit) module
Configuration of an individual OCU channel.

PARAMETER.PARAM_DESC: The physical hardware channel that is assigned to this logical channel. NOTE: This parameter is non-editable and not used. The hardware channel is configured through "GtmTimerUsed" parameter.

Maps an OCU channel to zero or multiple ECUC partitions to limit the access to this channel. The ECUC partitions referenced are a subset of the ECUC partitions where the OCU driver is mapped to. Note: Parameter support is added only for AUTOSAR schema compliance, this parameter is not used in code generation logic, hence this parameter is made editable false.

Channel Id of the OCU channel. This value will be assigned to the symbolic name derived from the OcuChannel container short name. It defines the assignment of the channel to the physical OCU hardware channel. The value of the parameter should be unique in a configuration set. NOTE: Minimum value is set as default value.

Specifies the tick duration of the counter of the channel. This parameter is the number of the input clock edges (rising edges or falling edges exclusively) counted each time to increase the counter by one unit. Note: This parameter is not-used,not editable and default value is set to 1.

Value of comparison threshold used for Initialization.(in ticks) The value should be less than the maximum counter value. For ATOM channel, OcuDefaultThreshold scaled up by amount of ticks should be in 24-bit range. For TOM channel, OcuDefaultThreshold scaled up by amount of ticks should be in 16-bit range. NOTE: Minimum value is set as default value.

This parameter is used to allow the OCU channel to trigger an ADC channel upon compare match. The value of the parameter represents the ADC Group to trigger. NOTE: Minimum value is set as default value.

This parameter is used to allow the OCU channel to trigger a DMA channel upon compare match The value of the parameter represents the DMA physical channel to trigger. NOTE: Minimum value is set as default value.

Maximum value in ticks, the counter of the OCU channel is able to count. For ATOM channel, OcuDefaultThreshold scaled up by amount of ticks should be in 24-bit range. For TOM channel, OcuDefaultThreshold scaled up by amount of ticks should be in 16-bit range. NOTE: Minimum value is set as default value.

The parameter is used by the OCU driver to invoke the user-defined function if the Compare match is detected. The parameter can be configured as a name or an address(numeric value) of the notification function. Note1: By default, the notification parameter will be NULL , to remove dependency from user defined functions. Note2: The OCU driver does not validate the configured function name or address for correctness and hence the responsibility falls on the user.

Information about the usage of an output pin on this channel. True: the channel uses an output pin. False: the channel does not use an output pin. NOTE: As the default HW used by the channel is set to TOM, and TOM cannot support any pin functionality, the default value is set to false.

The parameter OcuOutputPinDefaultState represents the state that a pin associated with a channel shall be set to after initialization. NOTE: OCU_LOW is set as default value as it represents the minimum numeric value.
PARAMETER.PARAM_RANGE: OCU_HIGH: The OCU channel output pin will be set to high (3 or 5 V) when requested. OCU_LOW: The OCU channel output pin will be set to low (0V) when requested.

ERROR_HANDLING.ERROR_HANDLING_DESC: This section describes the various errors reported by Ocu driver.

ERROR.ERR_DESC: Error code is reported when any OCU API services other than Ocu_GetVersionInfo() and Ocu_Init() are used without module initialization.
ERROR.APPLICABLE_API: Ocu_GetCounter, Ocu_SetAbsoluteThreshold, Ocu_EnableNotification, Ocu_DisableNotification, Ocu_StopChannel, Ocu_SetRelativeThreshold, Ocu_StartChannel, Ocu_DeInit, Ocu_SetPinAction, Ocu_SetPinState

ERROR.ERR_DESC: Error code is reported when OCU API used with an invalid channel identifier.
ERROR.APPLICABLE_API: Ocu_GetCounter, Ocu_SetAbsoluteThreshold, Ocu_EnableNotification, Ocu_DisableNotification, Ocu_StopChannel, Ocu_SetRelativeThreshold, Ocu_StartChannel, Ocu_SetPinAction, Ocu_SetPinState

ERROR.ERR_DESC: Error code is reported when API Ocu_SetPinState() called with an invalid pin state or when the channel is in the RUNNING state. Also in case, API Ocu_DeInit called when at least one of the OCU channel is in RUNNING state.
Error code is reported when API Ocu_SetPinAction() called with an invalid pin action.
Error code is reported on usage of Ocu_DisableNotification() or Ocu_EnableNotification() on a channel where a NULL pointer is configured as the notification function.
Error code is reported when OCU driver is already initialized and Ocu_Init() is called.
Error code is reported when a NULL pointer is passed an input parameter.
Error code is reported when API Ocu_StartChannel() called on a channel that is in state RUNNING.
Error code is reported when Ocu_SetPinState() or Ocu_SetPinAction() called for a channel that does not have an associated output pin.
Error code is reported when OCU initialization has failed. Example, selected configuration set does not exist.
Error code is reported when OCU module is not configured for the core in which an API is invoked.
Error code is reported when an API is called with the channel not allocated to executing core.
ERROR.APPLICABLE_API: Ocu_EnableNotification, Ocu_GetCounter, Ocu_SetAbsoluteThreshold, Ocu_DisableNotification, Ocu_StopChannel, Ocu_SetRelativeThreshold, Ocu_StartChannel, Ocu_SetPinAction, Ocu_SetPinState

ERROR.ERR_DESC: "OCU_E_PARAM_COMPARE_VALUE" error is reported to indicate invalid input compare values.
If the reference value is greater than the maximum threshold value then function Ocu_SetAbsoluteThreshold shall raise the error "OCU_E_PARAM_REF_VALUE".
If the ISR is invoked before OCU_Init then Ocu driver shall report a safety error "OCU_E_INVALID_ISR_UNINIT".
If the ISR is invoked when the channel is not active then Ocu driver shall report a safety error "OCU_E_INVALID_ISR_INACTIVE_CHANNEL"
The Ocu driver shall report a safety error, if ISR is invoked with wrong flags (Compare match notification flag) indicating unexpected compare match.
The Ocu driver shall report Safety error "OCU_E_INVALID_ISR_CHANNEL_INVALID", if the ISR is invoked when the passed channel ID is not configured.
The Ocu driver shall report DET/Safety error "OCU_E_INVALID_ISR_CHANNEL_CORE_MISMATCH", if the ISR is invoked when the passed channel and core id mismatch.

ELEMENT.NAME: GTM: primary hardware peripheral.
ELEMENT.DESC:
Hardware functional features The OCU driver uses the GTM IP (TOM/ATOM) for realizing the following features,
  • TOM CM1 compare match
  • ATOM CM1 compare match in SOMP mode
  • ATOM CM0/CM1 compare match in SOMC mode
  • ATOM in SOMC mode pin level changes, ADC trigger
  • ATOM in SOMP mode DMA trigger
  • TOM/ATOM notification
  • TOM DMA trigger
The key hardware functional features are:
  • Channel clock source configuration
  • Cyclic comparators for the compare match(ATOM SOMC mode - shared TBU clock)
  • Signaling mechanisms: Global enable/disable mechanism, output enable mechanism
  • ATOM operation mode are SOMP, SOMC
The unsupported features of the GTM-TOM/ATOM IP are:
  • Global force update signaling mechanism
  • Continuous down counting down mode, one shot up mode, one shot down mode
  • ATOM operational mode: SOMI or SOMS
  • TOM/ATOM - SOMP mode triggering port pin or ADC configuration
Users of the hardware The CMU functional block of the GTM peripheral and TBU_TS[x] timer are exclusively handled by the MCU driver. The MCU driver provides APIs to program the GTM SFRs. The OCU driver uses these APIs to write the GTM SFRs. Additionally, updates to the channel-specific SFRs are performed by the OCU driver. Since these channels are exclusively reserved for the OCU driver, access to the channel-specific SFRs from other drivers or user software is not allowed. The GTM TOM/ATOM functional blocks are used by PWM, GPT, WDG and OCU driver. Note: A TOM/ATOM channel of the GTM is exclusively used by its user. While users of TOM/ATOM channels are many, a channel is allocated to and used by exactly by one driver. Hardware diagnostic features Not applicable. Hardware events The OCU module uses the compare match events generated by the timer channel to provide notification of events to application and perform an action (pin level change, ADC trigger or DMA trigger) without software intervention. Mcu module is responsible for handling interrupts and invoking the callback function to service the interrupt.

ELEMENT.NAME: SCU: dependent hardware peripheral
ELEMENT.DESC: Hardware functional features The OCU driver depends on the SCU IP for the clock, ENDINIT and reset functionalities. The driver requires the fSPB and fGTM clock signals for functioning. Users of the hardware The SCU IP supplies clock for all the peripherals and the MCU driver, and is responsible for configuring the clock tree. To avoid conflicts due to simultaneous writes, update to all the ENDINIT protected registers is performed using the MCALLIB APIs. Hardware diagnostic features The SMU alarms configured for the SCU IP are not monitored by the OCU driver. Hardware events Hardware events from the SCU are not used by the OCU driver.

HW_SW_INTERFACE.RESPONSIBILITIES:
The OCU driver is responsible for triggering an event on a free- running counter compare match. The event can either be a pin level change, a DMA trigger, an ADC trigger or just a notification. The services provided by the OCU driver are:
  • Start/stop a channel
  • Configure the compare match values
  • Set the pin action on the sub-sequent compare matches
  • Enable/disable notifications and to set the pin level on a stopped channel
The TOM and ATOM slices of the GTM will be used to achieve the configured functionality. Note: The OCU driver does not support GTM-less device (for example, TC35x).

EXPORTED_AOUS.DESC: The AoU for the Ocu driver are as follows:

AOUS.NAME: Configuration pointer across multiple cores
AOUS.NOTES: User shall ensure, Configuration pointer passed for Ocu initialization should be same across all the configured cores.

AOUS.NAME: ADC trigger on Ocu_SetPinState
AOUS.NOTES: User shall be aware of, on configuring both ADC and port pin as a trigger on the OCU compare match. On Ocu_SetPinState API/function call, changing the port pin state may cause a change in the channel output signal. This would potentially cause an unexpected ADC trigger based on trigger edge configured for the ADC channel.

AOUS.NAME: Code generation
AOUS.NOTES: User shall ensure the generated configuration structures are correct against the intended GUI configurations.

AOUS.NAME: ADC trigger on both edges
AOUS.NOTES:
In case the OCU channel is configured only to support the ADC, the default compare match action is set to "Toggle".
Rationale: 1. As "Ocu_SetPinAction" and "Ocu_SetPinState" function are pre compile time configurable API ("Ocu_SetPinAction" and "Ocu_SetPinState" API are disabled, if pin actions are not configured on compare match). Therefore, users do not have an have option to set/change the Edge level(falling/raising) for triggering the ADC on a compare match. Hence, the compare match action is set to Toggle.

AOUS.NAME: Correctness of configuration pointer
AOUS.NOTES: User shall ensure the correct configuration pointer is being passed for initializing the Ocu driver.

AOUS.NAME: EVADC MUX configurations
AOUS.NOTES: User shall ensure that EVADC MUX configurations (that is, ADC channel connected to ATOM through EVADC MUX) are according to the group selection in the OCU configuration.

AOUS.NAME: Compare match event between Ocu_StartChannel and Ocu_EnableNotification
AOUS.NOTES: User shall be aware that if the compare match event occurs after Ocu_StartChannel but before Ocu_EnableNotification, no callback will be reported for that event. However, future compare match events will be notified through the callback.

AOUS.NAME: No ADC conversion
AOUS.NOTES:
In case OCU channel is configured to support both ADC and PORT, the default compare match action is set to NO ACTION. As PORT is enabled/configured to get triggered on compare match through "Ocu_SetPinAction" and "Ocu_SetPinState" APIs, Compare match action and current ADC signal level can be modified. Hence, user can configure ADC conversion on raising edge or falling edge or both the edges.
Scenario: When the initial state (ADC Trigger Signal) is not set to a desired value, the first compare match event may generate an edge, which may not trigger ADC conversion. For example: ADC configured for conversion on falling edge, initial state is already low and signal is toggled on next compare match(that is, The next compare match is the raising edge).
Hence user shall ensure output level is initialized before the Ocu start channel.

AOUS.NAME: No ADC trigger
AOUS.NOTES:
In case the OCU channel is configured to support both ADC and PORT, the default compare-match action is set to NO ACTION. As PORT is enabled/configured to get triggered on compare match, through "Ocu_SetPinAction" and "Ocu_SetPinState" APIs, compare -match action and current ADC signal level can be modified. Hence, user can configure ADC conversion on raising edge or falling edge or both edges.
Scenario: When the initial state (ADC trigger signal) is not set to a desired value, the first compare match event may not generate an edge required to trigger ADC conversion. For Example.: ADC configured for falling edge, initial state is already low and on next compare match the signal is configured to set LOW.
The user shall ensure output level is initialized before the start channel.

AOUS.NAME: Pin/ADC signal state on stop channel
AOUS.NOTES: User shall be aware that on calling the Ocu_StopChannel API, only compare match event notifications are disabled, but PIN state or ADC signal levels are unchanged. (For Example, When the ADC is configured as level trigger, on calling the Ocu_StopChannle API the ADC trigger levels are not changed).

AOUS.NAME: Port Pin state on deinit
AOUS.NOTES: User shall ensure, port pin is SET to the required state in GPIO mode before invoking the deinit Api. Rational: When deinit is invoked, all SFRs are placed to power on reset state and hence there may be a change on the output state of the channel.

AOUS.NAME: Return value of Ocu_SetAbsoluteThreshold/ Ocu_SetRelativeThreshold
AOUS.NOTES: In the Ocu_SetAbsoluteThreshold/ Ocu_SetRelativeThreshold Api, the OCU_CM_OUT_REF_INTERVAL is returned even in case of an error and it may lead to wrong system reaction. Hence user shall perform an explicit check of DET or SE error to validate the return value.

AOUS.NAME: Software Sequence on Ocu_Init
AOUS.NOTES: User shall ensure that the Mcu_Init and Port_Init API's are called before the Ocu_Init.

CALLOUT.CALLOUT_DESC: The driver does not support any callout functions.
